description: The Aster Plot is a unique and visually engaging custom visual for Power BI that combines aspects of both pie charts and radial bar charts. It enables users to visualize categorical data with two numerical metrics simultaneously—one represented by angle and the other by radius—providing a multi-dimensional way to explore proportions and comparisons. Key Features Displays data using both angular width and radial length. Allows users to show more information than a typical pie or donut chart. Supports dynamic formatting, tooltips, and interactive legends. Fully customizable with color, labels, tooltips, and sorting options. Responsive to Power BI slicers, filters, and drillthrough actions. Data Requirements To use the Aster Plot visual effectively, your dataset must include: 1 Dimension (Category): This defines each slice or segment of the Aster Plot. 1 Measure (Value): This determines both the angle and/or radius based on settings.
